subject.title: fix(ui): new sessions remember valid workspace and model choices

question: Should OpenClaw permanently remember each browser user's New Session workspace, worktree, model, and reasoning selections per Gateway and agent?
rationale: This is a new persisted user-preference behavior rather than a repair to an existing documented persistence guarantee, and the linked request remains explicitly marked for maintainer product review.

options.title: Sponsor browser-local preferences
options.body: Accept the per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent preference contract and proceed after current-head real behavior proof is added.

options.title: Keep New Session ephemeral
options.body: Decline persistent defaults and close or narrow the feature direction rather than introducing a new stored UI preference surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor browser-local preferences
recommendation.body: Accept the per-browser, per-Gateway, per-agent preference contract and proceed after current-head real behavior proof is added.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied history shows steipete carried the implementation and its subsequent correctness refinements.
